decisions.reason: The black-finish range is a surface variant of core drainage products that the firm makes with its existing manufacturing know-how, but as a trend-driven finish that is only mentioned on the website it carries some risk of consolidation.
The shower channel for seamless coverings builds directly on deep drainage expertise and the barrier-free strategy, and its dedicated page shows ongoing commitment.

The pump-assisted line stretches the firm's knowledge base, and the 2024 launch of the pump-drain channel (F) may make it redundant, but in-house R&D is still building pump know-how, so keeping it supports that learning for now.
The stainless steel design grate is core metal-fabrication competence aligned with the design-led positioning, so its results are easy to interpret and act on.
The newly launched pump-drain channel has a dedicated page and draws on knowledge gained from the pump-assisted line, so the firm is positioned to learn from its early results and improve it.
